---
title: "check-definite-antecedents.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only heuristic that flags a div
whose first sentence opens with a definite phrase and no link.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-19) is that a definite noun phrase
needs a clear antecedent,
linked to where it is introduced unless that is in the same div or passage.
This implements the check for
[psw#291](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/psw/issues/291).

A grammar-aware check is out of reach, so the check covers the clearest case.
The first sentence of a div's body (or of a file with no div)
starts with "The", "These", "Those", "This" or "That",
and holds no Markdown link, no `@` cross-reference and no `include` shortcode.
Nothing earlier in that div can be the antecedent,
so the reader has none unless a link supplies one.
The finding sits on that line.

The check does not count:

- code fences, HTML comments, YAML headers and headings;
- a first sentence that defines a bolded term, that is, one where "The" is followed
  by a term wrapped in double asterisks;
- a first sentence with a link, a cross-reference or an `include` shortcode.

A definition that starts "The covariance function must be ..."
is reported although it may be fine,
which is why the check never fails by default.

## Scope

Only a first sentence on a line a pull request adds is reported.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff
counts as moved rather than new, and a blank added line is not content.
With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked file in full on purpose.
Every run prints how many lines, files and divs it examined.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default    | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ---------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd'`  | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`       | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `false`    | Fail the workflow when a div opens with an unlinked definite phrase. The default gives warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`    | Scan every tracked file in full instead of only a PR's added lines. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`   | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

[`examples/check-definite-antecedents.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-definite-antecedents.yml)
